**Note:** Receiver wavelength ranges (1530–1580 nm on 4955, 1470–1510 nm on 5549) are paired with the opposite unit in the BiDi link; they are not separate modes because each ordering code is defined by its transmit channel (footnotes 1) and 2)). The unused pool values `1470`, `1510`, `1530`, and `1580` are receive-band limits for the complementary wavelength, not additional transmit modes for these part numbers.
